title: My Kinky Life - Kinkation (All Chapters)
description: I went on vacation for a week to a kinky summer camp. A giant festival of sexual freedom of every sort — especially kink! The most interesting and fun people watching EVER. You could be talking to someone one minute, and then the next see someone coming up behind them, and hooding them out of nowhere. To be followed by several more guys and girls, picking them up, and carrying them off, with their legs kicking. The best is when a flip-flop would come off and you see the last kidnapper straggle back to carry it then run off after the kicking legs and clusterfuck of kidnappers. Ok. Ok. Ok — Enough about that! This is a recounting of some of MY awesome real scenes I did while I was there. I have it split into four smaller chapters, or you can listen all together here in this one. For all you voyeurs out there, as well as those who want to know what real life kink is like.
author: Mistress Shibby
